steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: walls-tab
steps.eval: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('.finish-picker button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Walls'); if (!b) throw new Error('no Walls tab'); b.click(); })()

steps.name: open-add-select
steps.eval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Add an accent wall"]'); if (!b) throw new Error('no Add accent wall trigger'); b.click(); })()

steps.name: pick-east
steps.eval: (() => { const o = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role="option"]')].find(o => /East wall/.test(o.textContent)); if (!o) throw new Error('no East wall option: ' + [...document.querySelectorAll('[role="option"]')].map(x => x.textContent.trim()).join('|')); o.click(); })()

steps.name: choose-finish
steps.eval: (() => { const sw = [...document.querySelectorAll('.swatch, [class*=swatch]')].filter(e => e.closest('.panel')); const target = sw.find(e => /brick|red|fluted|oak/i.test(e.getAttribute('title') || e.getAttribute('aria-label') || e.textContent || '')) || sw[1] || sw[0]; if (!target) throw new Error('no swatches in accent picker'); target.click(); })()
